name: claude-toolkit
description: Reusable Claude Code plugins that help teams adopt configurable, verifiable AI-assisted workflows.

plugins.name: campaign-analysis
plugins.description: Answers recurring campaign-performance questions from a CSV export with reproducible calculations and optional Gmail drafting.

plugins.name: policy-assistant
plugins.description: Answers AI-tool policy questions from local Markdown documents with citations, effective-date handling, and a grounding hook.

plugins.name: deliverable-qa
plugins.description: Checks Markdown deliverables against a portable rulebook, recomputes defined metrics, and reports blockers and warnings.

plugins.name: segment-planner
plugins.description: Recommends eligible catalog segments for a brief and computes delivery estimates under a configurable targeting policy.

plugins.name: core-dev
plugins.description: Provides a debugging workflow, a read-only architecture reviewer, and opt-in conda and .env guard hooks.
